groups.defect: self.downsize is defined twice, so the new (from, to, dimensions, opts) version replaces the width/height version. Existing numeric callers break: 4-arg calls bind width/height into dimensions/opts and fail with a TypeError, and the 5-arg call in resize_emoji.rb:14 raises an ArgumentError.
groups.rationale: All five suggestions report the same root cause, a second downsize definition overriding the first. They differ only in which broken caller they use as the example, and one fix resolves all of them.

groups.defect: utilities.js hardcodes a 10MB limit at lines 182 and 246 instead of reading the per-type SiteSettings limit. This means admin-configured limits, including max_attachment_size_kb for non-image uploads, are no longer enforced, and the 413 alert shows the wrong limit.
groups.rationale: All three report the hardcoded 10MB cap that replaced the SiteSettings limits in the same file. One member adds that non-image attachments are now unchecked on both client and server, so the merged comment must include that point.
